CREATE TABLE "public"."adopters" (
  "address" text,
  "cpf" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "hasOtherPets" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "housingType" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "occupation" text,
  "otherPetsInfo" text,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."adoption_documents" (
  "adoptionProcessId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fileUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "signedAt" timestamptz,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "adoption_documents_type_check_0ca6472c" CHECK ("type" IN ('ADOPTION_TERM', 'SIGNATURE_PROOF', 'DELIVERY_RECEIPT', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."adoption_processes" (
  "adopterId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "animalId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "approvalDate" timestamptz,
  "compatibilityNotes" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveryDate" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "requestDate" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PRE_EVALUATION' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "adoption_processes_status_check_a3e79080" CHECK ("status" IN ('PRE_EVALUATION', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."animals" (
  "approximateAge" text,
  "arrivedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "breed" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "healthHistory" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "leftAt" timestamptz,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "neuterStatus" text DEFAULT 'NOT_NEUTERED' NOT NULL,
  "physicalTraits" text,
  "rescueConditions" text,
  "rescueDate" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "sex" text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' NOT NULL,
  "species" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'RESCUED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "animals_neuterStatus_check_5d2c685b" CHECK ("neuterStatus" IN ('NOT_NEUTERED', 'SCHEDULED', 'NEUTERED')),
  CONSTRAINT "animals_sex_check_35ee12d4" CHECK ("sex" IN ('MALE', 'FEMALE', 'UNKNOWN')),
  CONSTRAINT "animals_species_check_bc68df6f" CHECK ("species" IN ('DOG', 'CAT', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "animals_status_check_4d83131b" CHECK ("status" IN ('RESCUED', 'IN_TREATMENT', 'QUARANTINE', 'AVAILABLE_FOR_ADOPTION', 'ADOPTED', 'DECEASED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."attachments" (
  "animalId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "uploadedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "attachments_type_check_883f763b" CHECK ("type" IN ('PHOTO', 'VET_REPORT', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."donations" (
  "date" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "donorContact" text,
  "donorName" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "quantity" float8,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "unit" text,
  "value" float8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "donations_type_check_d8327d70" CHECK ("type" IN ('MONEY', 'FOOD', 'MEDICINE', 'HYGIENE', 'MATERIAL', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory_items" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "minThreshold" float8,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "inventory_items_category_check_2d8e1bca" CHECK ("category" IN ('FOOD', 'MEDICINE', 'HYGIENE', 'MATERIAL', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."medical_records" (
  "animalId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "clinic" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "veterinarian" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "medical_records_type_check_36d7dc0a" CHECK ("type" IN ('CONSULTATION', 'TREATMENT', 'MEDICATION', 'EXAM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "adoptionProcessId" int4,
  "animalId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "scheduledFor" timestamptz,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_type_check_ee3ebcf7" CHECK ("type" IN ('NEW_RESCUE', 'VACCINE_REMINDER', 'VET_FOLLOWUP', 'MEDICATION_REMINDER', 'CRITICAL_ANIMAL', 'ADOPTION_UPDATE', 'DONATION_CAMPAIGN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."resource_usages" (
  "animalId" int4,
  "date" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "inventoryItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "quantityUsed" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."surgeries" (
  "animalId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "clinic" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "performedDate" timestamptz,
  "scheduledDate" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "veterinarian" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "surgeries_status_check_78cb05f7" CHECK ("status" IN ('SCHEDULED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELED')),
  CONSTRAINT "surgeries_type_check_e687e185" CHECK ("type" IN ('CASTRATION', 'RECONSTRUCTIVE', 'EMERGENCY', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'STAFF' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_9882e4e8" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'STAFF', 'VET', 'VOLUNTEER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."vaccinations" (
  "animalId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "applicationDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nextDoseDate" timestamptz,
  "notes" text,
  "vaccineName" text NOT NULL,
  "veterinarian" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."volunteers" (
  "availability" text,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "volunteers_status_check_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)
